raw.details:
Overview

Build With Bharat 4.0 is India's premium national-level hackathon, organized by the CodeVerse Community in collaboration with KCC Institute of Technology & Management.

The hackathon brings together talented developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across the country to build impactful technology solutions for real-world challenges.

Taking place on 10–11 October 2026, this 24-hour offline hackathon provides participants with an opportunity to innovate, collaborate, learn from industry experts, showcase their skills, and compete for an exciting ₹1,00,000 Cash Prize Pool.

Event Details

  • Event Name: Build With Bharat 4.0
  • Organized By: CodeVerse Community
  • Venue: KCC Institute of Technology & Management
  • Date: 10–11 October 2026
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Mode: Offline
  • Participation Level: National
  • Team Size: 2–5 Members
  • Cash Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000
  • Certificates: Participation certificates for all eligible participants

Final Round – Participation, Food & Accommodation Fee

Participants who are selected for the Final Offline Round will be required to pay a nominal fee of ₹300 per participant, which will cover food (3 time meal) during the event.

Please note:

  • The ₹300 fee will be applicable only if you are selected for the Final Offline Round.

  • If you are not selected for the offline round, no payment will be required.

  • Every participant will receive a Participation Certificate, irrespective of whether they are selected for the Final Offline Round or not.

Eligibility

  • Open to Undergraduate and Postgraduate students across India.
  • Students from all branches and specializations are eligible.
  • Teams must consist of 2–5 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are welcome.
  • Participants from different colleges can form a single team.

Hackathon Journey

Phase 1 – Registration

Participants must register through the official registration portal before the registration deadline.

Phase 2 – Team Formation

Form a team of 2–5 members. Participants are encouraged to build diverse teams with members from different technical backgrounds and specializations.

Phase 3 – Idea Submission

Teams will submit their project idea in the prescribed PPT format. The official template and detailed submission guidelines will be shared by the organizing team.

Phase 4 – Shortlisting

Submitted ideas will be evaluated based on innovation, feasibility, technical potential, problem-solving approach, and impact.

Shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the offline finale at KCC Institute of Technology & Management.

Phase 5 – Grand Finale at KCC Institute of Technology & Management

Selected teams will participate in the 24-hour offline hackathon, where they will transform their ideas into working prototypes and solutions.

Throughout the hackathon, participants will have opportunities to interact with mentors, industry professionals, and fellow innovators for technical guidance, idea validation, and problem-solving support.

Phase 6 – Final Evaluation & Winner Announcement

Completed projects will be evaluated by an expert jury based on predefined judging criteria.

The winning teams will be announced during the closing ceremony and awarded from the ₹1,00,000 Cash Prize Pool.

Judging Criteria

Projects will be evaluated on the following parameters:

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Problem-Solving Approach
  • Technical Implementation
  • UI/UX & Design
  • Scalability & Impact
  • Presentation & Demonstration

Themes

Participants can build innovative solutions across a wide range of technology domains, including:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Web & Mobile Development
  • Blockchain & Web3
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud Computing
  • Internet of Things (IoT)
  • Open Innovation
  • Sustainability & Social Impact
  • EdTech & FinTech
  • Healthcare & Smart Solutions

Participants are also encouraged to explore interdisciplinary ideas and innovative solutions beyond the listed domains.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Team size must be 2–5 members.
  • Individual participation is not allowed.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are permitted.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops and required accessories.
  • Participants are responsible for bringing any additional hardware or components required for their projects.
  • All projects must be developed during the designated hackathon period, wherever applicable.
  • Any form of plagiarism, impersonation, or unfair practice will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Teams must follow the instructions and timelines communicated by the organizing team.
  • The organizing team reserves the right to modify the rules, schedule, or guidelines if required.
  • Judges' decisions will be final and binding.

Rewards & Benefits

  • ₹1,00,000 Cash Prize Pool
  • Participation & Winner Certificates
  • Exclusive Goodies & Swags
  • Mentorship from Industry Experts
  • Networking Opportunities
  • Exposure to Developers, Innovators & Technology Communities
  • Internship & Career Opportunities, subject to partner availability
  • Opportunity to showcase projects to industry professionals and experts
  • Hands-on experience of building technology solutions under a real hackathon environment
  • 3-time meals during the hackathon
  • Stay/accommodation during the hackathon period

Communication

For important announcements, schedules, PPT templates, shortlisted teams, venue instructions, problem statements, rules, and other event updates, participants are requested to join the official communication group.

Build. Innovate. Lead.

Join Build With Bharat 4.0 at KCC Institute of Technology & Management and become part of one of India's premium student hackathon experiences.

Collaborate with talented innovators from across the country, transform your ideas into impactful technology solutions, learn from industry experts, and compete for a ₹1,00,000 Cash Prize Pool.

This October, don't just participate — Build With Bharat.
